none: PAS LIN-EDB73D: Roman nummus of the house of Constantine
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

An incomplete and worn Roman copper-alloy contemporary copy of a nummus of the House of Constantine dating to AD 330-335 (Reece Period 17). GLORIA EXERC-ITVS reverse type depicting two soldiers holding spear and shield; two standards between them. Mint illegible. Obverse description: Illegible. Obverse inscription: Illegible.
